app.name: Wii Ran AI
app.short_description: Local stories and chat on your Wii
app.long_description: Choose StoryBananaMind-7.5M for stories or experimental BananaMind Nano Chat for replies that may be wrong. Both run offline. D-pad selects, A types, B deletes, Minus spaces, Plus generates, Home quits. 256-char input; 2,048-token chat context.
